 France Latest: Fabien Galthié Suffers Crucial Injury Blow Ahead Of Los Pumas Test 
 France latest: Fabien Galthié suffers crucial injury blow ahead of Los Pumas Test
 Louis Chapman Coombe & James While 
 21 Nov 2026 12:32 PM 
 Planet Rugby understands Jean-Baptiste Gros (pictured) is out of France's clash v Argentina 
 France have suffered a crucial injury blow ahead of Saturday’s Nations Championship Test against Los Pumas, with loosehead prop Jean-Baptiste Gros withdrawing.  
 The Toulon front-rower was set to start at the Stade de France for Les Bleus’ critical meeting with Argentina, but Planet Rugby can reveal he is now set to miss the Test and the remainder of the Nations Championship campaign through injury.
 This comes amid a growing injury crisis for Fabien Galthi é  during November, with as many as 25 squad members ruled out at the time of writing.
 France suffer crucial injury blow ahead of Los Pumas showdown
 Galthi é does have several options to replace Gros in the side this weekend. PR understands Moses Alo-Emile has been drafted into the wider squad with immediate effect, while Jefferson Poirot and Rodrigue Neti are also options.
 Bordeaux-Bègles ace Poirot would be in pole position to slot into the run-on group after initially being named on the bench for the Test against Argentina, while Toulouse man Neti also featured against the Springboks.
 At the time of writing, France have not confirmed a replacement for Gros in their match-day squad.
 Ireland v South Africa prediction: Rassie-less Springboks to blast to Dublin victory amid Farrell’s ‘bravest’ call 
 However, that is understood to be the sole alteration to the 23-man squad for Saturday’s Test in Paris from the team that was announced on Thursday, as France eye up a spot in the Nations Championship final.
 Théo Attissogbe starts at full-back, with Aaron Grandidier-Nkanang and Louis Bielle-Biarrey named on the wings. Kalvin Gourgues and Yoram Moefana continue in the centres, while Matthieu Jalibert and captain Antoine Dupont rekindle their half-back partnership.
 Want more from Planet Rugby? Add us as a preferred source on Google to your favourites list for world-class coverage you can trust. 
 Anthony Jelonch, Charles Ollivon and Esteban Capilla start in the back-row, with Mickaël Guillard and Florian Verhaeghe in the locks. Sipili Falatea and Peato Mauvaka join Poirot in the new run-on front-row.
 Maxime Lamothe, Régis Montagne, Tyler Duguid, Cameron Woki, Grégory Alldritt, Maxime Lucu and Emilien Gailleton join the aforementioned Neti on the replacements list.

 Updated France team to face Argentina in full
 Starting XV:  15 Théo Attissogbe, 14 Aaron Grandidier-Nkanang, 13 Kalvin Gourgues, 12 Yoram Moefana, 11 Louis Bielle-Biarrey, 10 Matthieu Jalibert, 9 Antoine Dupont (c), 8 Anthony Jelonch, 7 Charles Ollivon, 6 Esteban Capilla, 5 Mickaël Guillard, 4 Florian Verhaeghe, 3 Sipili Falatea, 2 Peato Mauvaka, 1 TBC
 Replacements:  16 Maxime Lamothe, 17 TBC, 18 Régis Montagne, 19 Tyler Duguid, 20 Cameron Woki, 21 Grégory Alldritt, 22 Maxime Lucu, 23 Emilien Gailleton
 Date: Saturday, 21 November 2026
 Venue: Stade de France, Saint-Denis
 Kick-off: 21:10 (local), 20:10 (UK), 21:10 (France), 22:10 (South Africa), 07:10 (22 November, AEDT), 09:10 (22 November, New Zealand), 17:10 (Argentina), 05:10 (22 November, JST), 15:10 (EST)
 Referee: Hollie Davidson (SRU)
 Assistant Referees: Sam Grove-White (SRU) and Matthew Carley (RFU)
 TMO: Mike Adamson (SRU)
